A steaming hot bowl of cơm gà rau thơm, a beloved Vietnamese chicken and rice dish, sits invitingly on a rustic wooden table in a cozy eatery. Rau thơm, commonly known as mint in Vietnamese cuisine, is a versatile herb known for its refreshing crunch and aromatic fragrance. This dish features mint leaves, along with other aromatic herbs like cilantro and basil, enhancing the dish's savory flavors and providing a delightful contrast to the rich, tender chicken and fluffy rice. The mint adds a vibrant green touch and a crisp texture that complements the warm and hearty elements of the dish, enhancing its visual appeal.
